original_ai_output.title_zh: 心脏病专家警告战斗压力对士兵的影响
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚一名军方心脏病专家警告称，激烈的战斗情境可能引发士兵显著的心血管反应，长期压力可能影响其心脏健康。他呼吁重视军人心理健康，不应将相关症状视为装病或软弱。该专家还建议通过战术呼吸、常规健康监测和可穿戴设备等方式进行干预。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚军方心脏病专家警告激烈战斗可能引发士兵显著心血管反应
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A Military Cardiologist, Maj.-Gen. Life Ajemba, has warned that intense combat situations could trigger significant cardiovascular responses in soldiers

key_facts.fact: 专家称反复暴露于创伤事件可能导致部分人员出现作战压力或创伤后应激障碍
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: repeated exposure to traumatic incidents, including witnessing the death or severe injury of colleagues, could also leave some personnel with operational stress or post-traumatic stress disorder

key_facts.fact: 专家呼吁不应将心理健康症状视为装病或软弱
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: stressing that symptoms should not be dismissed as malingering or weakness

key_facts.fact: 专家在阿布贾接受尼日利亚通讯社采访时发出上述警告
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ajemba gave the warning in an interview with the News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) Abuja on Wednesday

uncertainties: 该报道为单一来源（尼日利亚通讯社），尚缺乏交叉验证
